thread:
elsa: Quick decision sync — we need a binding roadmap for private deploys that customers can opt into without network rework. Main asks: stable egress IP, non-disruptive upgrades, and straightforward KMS/HSM onboarding.
greg: High level lanes I'd push: (A) Installer-only (preflight + minimal agent), (B) Egress-anchor operator (host-preserve), (C) Relay-fallback for NATed sites, (D) Regulated bundle (airgap + KMS samples).
sophia: Acceptance criteria proposal: upgrade success >=98% in harness; median rollback <= 8m; egress-preserve >=90% for host-network installs; KMS onboarding doc + sample configs for 2 vendors.
yusuf: Field note: two finance customers will delay without HSM in lane D. One large customer refuses app-layer proxies — requires host-source preservation.
greg: Technical options for egress-preserve: hostNetwork daemonset (fast), TPROXY (flexible but kernel deps), or sidecar iptables rules (less ideal). Each has tradeoffs in security and ops complexity.
sophia: Preflight checklist (to surface in installer UI): outbound connectivity, CA bundle present, disk space, KMS handshake. Minimal preflight snippet: 
```
# preflight quick checks
curl -sf https://status.redwood.local/ok || echo "connectivity-fail"
openssl s_client -connect kms.example.com:443 -brief || echo "kms-fail"
```
elsa: Canary plan (small, measurable):
- round 0: internal + 1 friendly customer (smoke)
- round 1: 3 customers across lanes A/B/C
- metrics: install success, upgrade delta, rollback time, token p95/p99 latency, cpu overhead
greg: Perf budgets: relay P95 added latency <50ms; operator CPU host overhead <5%; token throughput regression <10% in canaries.
yusuf: Runbook essentials: preflight pass -> scheduled window -> install agent/operator -> validate egress/preserve-ip -> smoke traffic -> monitor 30m -> rollback if health fails. Document rollback commands and escalation path.
sophia: Test matrix to automate in staging: single-node airgapped, multi-node NATed VPC, peered DC with preserved egress, hybrid clusters. Add nightly CI jobs for preflight + install flows.
greg: Owners/quick deps: installer UI & preflight (elsa), operator implementation (greg), KMS adapter + docs (sophia), relay perf harness (yusuf), canary coordination (product ops).
elsa: Timeline ask: 1-week spike to prove host-preserve approach; 2-week sprint for operator v0 + preflight; 2-week canary window. Target first canary before end of quarter.
yusuf: Customer comms: prepare signup form and maintenance window options. Ops-bot, reserve tentative slot.
deploy-bot: Tentative maintenance window reserved: 2024-09-18 01:00-04:00 UTC.
sophia: Risks quick log:
- Relay may bust latency SLAs — mitigation: local cache + rate limits.
- HSM vendor variability — mitigation: provide generic KMS shim + vendor notes.
- Airgapped CA issues — mitigation: explicit CA import step in installer + docs.
greg: Final ask: product signoff on lanes, acceptance criteria, owners by COB Monday. @elsa @sophia @yusuf please ack.
elsa: Ack — I'll assemble the launch checklist and post to roadmap doc.
sophia: Ack, will draft KMS adapter spec and sample config.
yusuf: Ack, I'll start relay perf harness and book canary POCs.
greg: Thanks — I'll kick off operator spike tomorrow and post status.
